justification_notes.why_holdout_not_discovery: Holdout is the most recent pre-freeze era and the decisive V1 evidence slice; discovery/validation already consumed for selection.
justification_notes.why_50pct_retention: Historical effect is small (~28–36 bps / 10 sessions). Requiring 100% retention would conflate sampling noise with failure. Requiring only sign would be too weak for confirmation. Half of holdout incremental is a pre-registered economically modest floor that still demands material replication of the V1 effect class.
justification_notes.why_not_p_value_primary: V1 did not pre-register a confirmatory p-value; inventing a new α after freeze would be arbitrary. Direction + retention + breadth + concentration + stability + price-control are the confirmatory battery.

D_concentration.sector_rule: If sector mapping unavailable, skip sector test and record SECTOR_UNAVAILABLE; do not invent sectors.

rules: After dropping the single calendar month with largest positive contribution to candidate sum of T10 returns, incremental_mean_ret must remain > 0
No single calendar month may account for > 50% of the absolute sum of candidate T10 returns

controls_frozen: px_ret_20 (T0 close / close_t-20 - 1) when 20 prior sessions exist

tests.name: residual_after_ols_px_ret_20
tests.rule: OLS of ret_t10 on const + px_ret_20 within confirmation matured sample; mean residual on candidate rows minus mean residual on baseline rows must have sign + and magnitude >= 0.25 * raw incremental

tests.name: tercile_sign_majority
tests.rule: Split matured eligible universe into terciles of px_ret_20; candidate incremental vs within-tercile baseline must be > 0 in at least 2 of 3 terciles

exclude_if: unresolved CA anomaly flagged by operator DQ gate
G_corporate_action_robustness.note: Same V1 filters; raw OHLC CA status remains unknown — document caveat, do not silently impute.

rules: After dropping strongest positive calendar month, incremental_mean_ret must remain > 0
No single calendar month > 50% of abs sum of candidate T10 returns

B_magnitude_retention.rule: incremental_mean_ret_t10 <= 0.50 * historical_holdout_incremental (more negative or equal to half of holdout magnitude)

rules: After dropping strongest negative calendar month, incremental_mean_ret must remain < 0
No single calendar month > 50% of abs sum of candidate T10 returns

F_price_control_survival.note: Anti-edge: residual incremental after px_ret_20 OLS must remain negative with magnitude >= 0.25 * |raw incremental|

FFC1_OPTIONAL_STREAK_NEG_LE_M5_T10.exploratory_status_note: Optional anti-edge remains labeled EXPLORATORY in operator output even if CONFIRMED/FAILED under these criteria.

final_states.CONFIRMED: All of A–H pass at preferred window (or at max patience if preferred reached early metrics already stable and preferred thresholds met).
final_states.FAILED_CONFIRMATION: Preferred window matured sample meets breadth minima but any of A–H fails.
final_states.INCONCLUSIVE: Maximum patience window exhausted without meeting breadth minima, or data-quality coverage too poor to judge.
